records.key: Cellpose *_seg.npy bundles use their separate editor route. Open this bundle in Make Masks, or choose an image file for conversion.
records.source: Cellpose *_seg.npy bundles use their separate editor route. Open this bundle in Make Masks, or choose an image file for conversion.
records.translation: Los paquetes Cellpose *_seg.npy usan su propio acceso al editor. Abra este paquete en Make Masks o elija un archivo de imagen para la conversión.

records.key: NPY header is missing, invalid, or too large: {path}. Choose a valid NPY image, or export it again from the original data, then preview the import again.
records.source: NPY header is missing, invalid, or too large: {path}. Choose a valid NPY image, or export it again from the original data, then preview the import again.
records.translation: Falta la cabecera NPY, no es válida o es demasiado grande: {path}. Elija una imagen NPY válida o vuelva a exportarla desde los datos originales y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la importación.

records.key: NPY import requires a real numeric array without objects or structured fields. Export the image as a numeric NPY array or TIFF, then preview the import again.
records.source: NPY import requires a real numeric array without objects or structured fields. Export the image as a numeric NPY array or TIFF, then preview the import again.
records.translation: La importación NPY requiere un array numérico real sin objetos ni campos estructurados. Exporte la imagen como array NPY numérico o como TIFF y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la importación.

records.key: NPY import requires a two-dimensional YX image; arrays with other dimensions need explicit axis selection. Select an image plane and export it as a two-dimensional NPY or TIFF, then preview the import again.
records.source: NPY import requires a two-dimensional YX image; arrays with other dimensions need explicit axis selection. Select an image plane and export it as a two-dimensional NPY or TIFF, then preview the import again.
records.translation: La importación NPY requiere una imagen YX de dos dimensiones; los arrays con otras dimensiones necesitan una selección explícita de ejes. Seleccione un plano de la imagen, expórtelo como NPY o TIFF de dos dimensiones y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la importación.

records.key: NPY data is truncated: {path}. Restore or export the complete file from the original data, then preview the import again.
records.source: NPY data is truncated: {path}. Restore or export the complete file from the original data, then preview the import again.
records.translation: Los datos NPY están truncados: {path}. Restaure o exporte el archivo completo desde los datos originales y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la importación.

records.key: Source folder does not exist: {src!r}. Choose an existing image folder, then preview the import again.
records.source: Source folder does not exist: {src!r}. Choose an existing image folder, then preview the import again.
records.translation: La carpeta de origen no existe: {src!r}. Elija una carpeta de imágenes existente y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la importación.

records.key: Multi-frame raster images need explicit frame or axis selection; no frames were imported. Export the required frame as a single-frame TIFF or PNG, then import that file.
records.source: Multi-frame raster images need explicit frame or axis selection; no frames were imported. Export the required frame as a single-frame TIFF or PNG, then import that file.
records.translation: Las imágenes ráster con varios fotogramas requieren una selección explícita de fotogramas o ejes; no se importó ningún fotograma. Exporte el fotograma necesario como TIFF o PNG de un solo fotograma y, después, importe ese archivo.

records.key: src is a required parameter. Choose a source image folder before starting Mask.
records.source: src is a required parameter. Choose a source image folder before starting Mask.
records.translation: src es un parámetro obligatorio. Elija una carpeta de imágenes de origen antes de iniciar Máscaras.

records.key: src must be a string or a list of strings. Choose a source folder in Mask, or supply src as a folder path or list of folder paths.
records.source: src must be a string or a list of strings. Choose a source folder in Mask, or supply src as a folder path or list of folder paths.
records.translation: src debe ser una cadena o una lista de cadenas. Elija una carpeta de origen en Máscaras o indique src como ruta de carpeta o lista de rutas de carpeta.

records.key: Bad settings: tables={tables!r}. Select at least one measured object table in Tables and remove duplicate or unsupported names.
records.source: Bad settings: tables={tables!r}. Select at least one measured object table in Tables and remove duplicate or unsupported names.
records.translation: Preferencias incorrectas: tables={tables!r}. Seleccione al menos una tabla de objetos medidos en Tablas y elimine los nombres duplicados o no admitidos.

records.key: dataset_mode='annotation' needs annotation_column set to a column of png_list. Nothing else in these settings says which labels to train on. Choose the annotation column in the ML settings, or label objects in Annotate before training.
records.source: dataset_mode='annotation' needs annotation_column set to a column of png_list. Nothing else in these settings says which labels to train on. Choose the annotation column in the ML settings, or label objects in Annotate before training.
records.translation: dataset_mode='annotation' requiere que annotation_column indique una columna de png_list. Ninguna otra opción de esta configuración indica con qué etiquetas entrenar. Elija la columna de anotaciones en la configuración de aprendizaje automático o etiquete objetos en Anotación antes de entrenar.

records.key: png_list needs the columns 'prcfo' and {annotation_column!r} to train on annotations; it has: {columns}. Choose a database from a completed Measure run and an annotation column created in Annotate.
records.source: png_list needs the columns 'prcfo' and {annotation_column!r} to train on annotations; it has: {columns}. Choose a database from a completed Measure run and an annotation column created in Annotate.
records.translation: png_list necesita las columnas 'prcfo' y {annotation_column!r} para entrenar con anotaciones; contiene: {columns}. Elija una base de datos de una ejecución completada de Medición y una columna de anotaciones creada en Anotación.

records.source: {name} could not be written. Choose an existing folder you can write to and check free disk space, then save the picture again.

Error de exportación: {error}

records.key:
Command failed (%s):

records.source:

records.translation:
Ha fallado el comando (%s):
%s. Lea la salida del comando que aparece arriba, resuelva la causa indicada y, después, reintente la actualización.

records.key: Command timed out after %s seconds. Read the command log to find the stalled step, check its connection or dependency state, then retry the update.
records.source: Command timed out after %s seconds. Read the command log to find the stalled step, check its connection or dependency state, then retry the update.
records.translation: Se agotó el tiempo del comando tras %s segundos. Lea el registro del comando para localizar el paso detenido, compruebe su conexión o el estado de sus dependencias y, después, reintente la actualización.

records.key: Unknown metadata_type {key!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select a supported filename convention from the listed choices, then preview the input again.
records.source: Unknown metadata_type {key!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select a supported filename convention from the listed choices, then preview the input again.
records.translation: metadata_type desconocido {key!r}; se esperaba uno de {choices}. Seleccione una convención de nombres de archivo admitida entre las opciones indicadas y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la entrada.

records.key: Indexed ScanR requires a CSV map with plate, index and well columns. Create or select a local well map CSV that assigns every acquired plate/W index to its physical well, then preview again.
records.source: Indexed ScanR requires a CSV map with plate, index and well columns. Create or select a local well map CSV that assigns every acquired plate/W index to its physical well, then preview again.
records.translation: ScanR indexado requiere un mapa CSV con las columnas plate, index y well. Cree o seleccione un CSV local de mapa de pocillos que asigne cada índice placa/W adquirido a su pocillo físico y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: The well map has no assignment for: {indices}. Add the missing plate/index rows with their physical well assignments, then preview again.
records.source: The well map has no assignment for: {indices}. Add the missing plate/index rows with their physical well assignments, then preview again.
records.translation: El mapa de pocillos no tiene asignación para: {indices}. Añada las filas placa/índice que faltan con sus pocillos físicos asignados y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Unknown layout {layout!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select one of the listed layouts to match the source folders, then preview again.
records.source: Unknown layout {layout!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select one of the listed layouts to match the source folders, then preview again.
records.translation: Disposición desconocida {layout!r}; se esperaba una de {choices}. Seleccione una de las disposiciones indicadas que coincida con las carpetas de origen y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Unknown z_handling {z_handling!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select one of the listed Z handling options, then preview again.
records.source: Unknown z_handling {z_handling!r}; expected one of {choices}. Select one of the listed Z handling options, then preview again.
records.translation: z_handling desconocido {z_handling!r}; se esperaba uno de {choices}. Seleccione una de las opciones de tratamiento de Z indicadas y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Unknown plate_naming {plate_naming!r}; expected "index" or "name". Set plate_naming to index or name, then preview again.
records.source: Unknown plate_naming {plate_naming!r}; expected "index" or "name". Set plate_naming to index or name, then preview again.
records.translation: plate_naming desconocido {plate_naming!r}; se esperaba "index" o "name". Establezca plate_naming en index o name y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Raster image dimensions or channels changed after the import preview: {path}. Keep the source file unchanged and preview the import again before converting.
records.source: Raster image dimensions or channels changed after the import preview: {path}. Keep the source file unchanged and preview the import again before converting.
records.translation: Las dimensiones o los canales de la imagen ráster cambiaron después de la vista previa de importación: {path}. No modifique el archivo de origen y vuelva a previsualizar la importación antes de convertir.

records.key: NPY source shape or dtype changed after the import preview: {path}. Keep the source file unchanged and preview the import again before converting.
records.source: NPY source shape or dtype changed after the import preview: {path}. Keep the source file unchanged and preview the import again before converting.
records.translation: La forma o el dtype del origen NPY cambió después de la vista previa de importación: {path}. No modifique el archivo de origen y vuelva a previsualizar la importación antes de convertir.

records.key: Map file does not exist: {path}. Select an existing conversion map CSV from the conversion output folder, then retry.
records.source: Map file does not exist: {path}. Select an existing conversion map CSV from the conversion output folder, then retry.
records.translation: El archivo de mapa no existe: {path}. Seleccione un CSV de mapa de conversión existente de la carpeta de salida de la conversión y, después, vuelva a intentarlo.

records.key: Plate barcode input is not a local file: {path}. Provide the intended barcode input as an existing local file at this path, then preview again.
records.source: Plate barcode input is not a local file: {path}. Provide the intended barcode input as an existing local file at this path, then preview again.
records.translation: La entrada de códigos de barras de placa no es un archivo local: {path}. Proporcione la entrada de códigos de barras prevista como un archivo local existente en esta ruta y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Plate barcode input exceeds 16 MiB: {path}. Create a smaller input file containing the records needed for this conversion, at most 16 MiB, then preview again.
records.source: Plate barcode input exceeds 16 MiB: {path}. Create a smaller input file containing the records needed for this conversion, at most 16 MiB, then preview again.
records.translation: La entrada de códigos de barras de placa supera 16 MiB: {path}. Cree un archivo de entrada más pequeño, de 16 MiB como máximo, con los registros necesarios para esta conversión y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode sidecars must not be symbolic links: {path}. Copy the intended barcode text into a regular barcode.txt file at this path, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode sidecars must not be symbolic links: {path}. Copy the intended barcode text into a regular barcode.txt file at this path, then preview again.
records.translation: Los archivos auxiliares de códigos de barras no pueden ser enlaces simbólicos: {path}. Copie el texto de códigos de barras previsto en un archivo barcode.txt normal en esta ruta y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode sidecar exceeds 64 KiB: {path}. Keep only barcode assignments for these source plates in barcode.txt, with a total size of at most 64 KiB, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode sidecar exceeds 64 KiB: {path}. Keep only barcode assignments for these source plates in barcode.txt, with a total size of at most 64 KiB, then preview again.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras supera 64 KiB: {path}. Deje en barcode.txt solo las asignaciones de códigos de barras de estas placas de origen, con un tamaño total de 64 KiB como máximo, y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode sidecar changed while being read: {path}. Finish saving barcode.txt, preview again, and keep the file unchanged during preview and conversion.
records.source: Barcode sidecar changed while being read: {path}. Finish saving barcode.txt, preview again, and keep the file unchanged during preview and conversion.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras cambió mientras se leía: {path}. Termine de guardar barcode.txt, vuelva a previsualizar y no modifique el archivo durante la vista previa ni la conversión.

records.key: Barcode sidecar is empty or contains control characters: {path}. Enter a barcode or source_plate=barcode assignments in barcode.txt and remove non-text control characters, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode sidecar is empty or contains control characters: {path}. Enter a barcode or source_plate=barcode assignments in barcode.txt and remove non-text control characters, then preview again.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras está vacío o contiene caracteres de control: {path}. Escriba un código de barras o asignaciones source_plate=barcode en barcode.txt y elimine los caracteres de control no textuales; después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Convert plate_barcode_source must be a local CSV file. Save or export the barcode records as a CSV on this computer and select that file, then preview again.
records.source: Convert plate_barcode_source must be a local CSV file. Save or export the barcode records as a CSV on this computer and select that file, then preview again.
records.translation: plate_barcode_source de la conversión debe ser un archivo CSV local. Guarde o exporte los registros de códigos de barras como CSV en este equipo, seleccione ese archivo y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode linkage needs a destination separate from the source tree. Choose a destination outside the source folder that also does not contain the source folder, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode linkage needs a destination separate from the source tree. Choose a destination outside the source folder that also does not contain the source folder, then preview again.
records.translation: La vinculación de códigos de barras necesita un destino separado del árbol de origen. Elija un destino fuera de la carpeta de origen que tampoco contenga la carpeta de origen y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Plate barcode bundle already exists: {bundle}. Choose a new destination folder, then preview again to preserve the existing barcode bundle.
records.source: Plate barcode bundle already exists: {bundle}. Choose a new destination folder, then preview again to preserve the existing barcode bundle.
records.translation: El paquete de códigos de barras de placa ya existe: {bundle}. Elija una nueva carpeta de destino y, después, vuelva a previsualizar para conservar el paquete de códigos de barras existente.

records.key: No planned image wells to link by barcode. Select a source folder containing readable supported images, resolve any scan errors, and preview again before linking barcodes.
records.source: No planned image wells to link by barcode. Select a source folder containing readable supported images, resolve any scan errors, and preview again before linking barcodes.
records.translation: No hay pocillos de imagen planificados para vincular por código de barras. Seleccione una carpeta de origen con imágenes admitidas y legibles, resuelva los errores de escaneo y vuelva a previsualizar antes de vincular códigos de barras.

records.key: plate_barcodes or unambiguous barcode.txt inputs must name every output plate, and no others: {plates}. Enter an output barcode for each listed plate, remove assignments for other output plates, and preview again.
records.source: plate_barcodes or unambiguous barcode.txt inputs must name every output plate, and no others: {plates}. Enter an output barcode for each listed plate, remove assignments for other output plates, and preview again.
records.translation: Las entradas plate_barcodes o barcode.txt sin ambigüedad deben nombrar todas las placas de salida, y ninguna otra: {plates}. Escriba un código de barras de salida para cada placa indicada, elimine las asignaciones de otras placas de salida y vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Conversion is incomplete; no plate barcode bundle was written. Review the skipped or failed images in the conversion report, resolve those failures, and preview and run the conversion again before linking barcodes.
records.source: Conversion is incomplete; no plate barcode bundle was written. Review the skipped or failed images in the conversion report, resolve those failures, and preview and run the conversion again before linking barcodes.
records.translation: La conversión está incompleta; no se escribió ningún paquete de códigos de barras de placa. Revise las imágenes omitidas o fallidas en el informe de conversión, resuelva esos fallos y vuelva a previsualizar y ejecutar la conversión antes de vincular códigos de barras.

records.key: metadata_type='custom' needs custom_regex: a pattern with named groups wellID, fieldID and chanID. Enter custom_regex with these named groups, or select a built-in filename convention, then preview the input again.
records.source: metadata_type='custom' needs custom_regex: a pattern with named groups wellID, fieldID and chanID. Enter custom_regex with these named groups, or select a built-in filename convention, then preview the input again.
records.translation: metadata_type='custom' necesita custom_regex: un patrón con los grupos con nombre wellID, fieldID y chanID. Escriba custom_regex con estos grupos con nombre o seleccione una convención de nombres de archivo integrada y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la entrada.

records.key: The well map must have exactly plate,index,well columns. Choose or create a CSV with only these three columns in this order, then preview again.
records.source: The well map must have exactly plate,index,well columns. Choose or create a CSV with only these three columns in this order, then preview again.
records.translation: El mapa de pocillos debe tener exactamente las columnas plate,index,well. Elija o cree un CSV con solo estas tres columnas en este orden y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: The well map contains an invalid plate, W index or physical well. Enter a nonempty plate name, a W index such as W00001, and a physical well such as A01 for each row, then preview again.
records.source: The well map contains an invalid plate, W index or physical well. Enter a nonempty plate name, a W index such as W00001, and a physical well such as A01 for each row, then preview again.
records.translation: El mapa de pocillos contiene una placa, un índice W o un pocillo físico no válido. Escriba en cada fila un nombre de placa no vacío, un índice W como W00001 y un pocillo físico como A01 y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: The well map repeats a plate/index or physical well. Give each plate/index one row and each physical well one index per plate, then preview again.
records.source: The well map repeats a plate/index or physical well. Give each plate/index one row and each physical well one index per plate, then preview again.
records.translation: El mapa de pocillos repite una combinación placa/índice o un pocillo físico. Asigne a cada combinación placa/índice una sola fila y a cada pocillo físico un solo índice por placa y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: {path} could not be read as a conversion map: {exc}. Check that the file is readable and select the conversion map CSV written by spaCR, then retry.
records.source: {path} could not be read as a conversion map: {exc}. Check that the file is readable and select the conversion map CSV written by spaCR, then retry.
records.translation: No se pudo leer {path} como mapa de conversión: {exc}. Compruebe que el archivo se puede leer, seleccione el CSV de mapa de conversión escrito por spaCR y vuelva a intentarlo.

records.key: Cannot safely read barcode sidecar {path}: {exc}. Check that barcode.txt is readable and is a regular file, then preview again.
records.source: Cannot safely read barcode sidecar {path}: {exc}. Check that barcode.txt is readable and is a regular file, then preview again.
records.translation: No se puede leer de forma segura el archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras {path}: {exc}. Compruebe que barcode.txt se puede leer y es un archivo normal y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode sidecar must contain UTF-8 text: {path}. Save barcode.txt as UTF-8 plain text, then preview the input again.
records.source: Barcode sidecar must contain UTF-8 text: {path}. Save barcode.txt as UTF-8 plain text, then preview the input again.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras debe contener texto UTF-8: {path}. Guarde barcode.txt como texto sin formato UTF-8 y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la entrada.

records.key: Barcode sidecar needs source_plate=barcode entries: {path}. Write one source_plate=barcode assignment per line, using the source plate names shown in the preview.
records.source: Barcode sidecar needs source_plate=barcode entries: {path}. Write one source_plate=barcode assignment per line, using the source plate names shown in the preview.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras necesita entradas source_plate=barcode: {path}. Escriba una asignación source_plate=barcode por línea con los nombres de placa de origen que aparecen en la vista previa.

records.key: Barcode sidecar has unknown, empty or duplicate assignments: {path}. Use known source plate names, provide a barcode after each '=', and remove repeated assignments, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode sidecar has unknown, empty or duplicate assignments: {path}. Use known source plate names, provide a barcode after each '=', and remove repeated assignments, then preview again.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras tiene asignaciones desconocidas, vacías o duplicadas: {path}. Use nombres de placa de origen conocidos, indique un código de barras después de cada '=' y elimine las asignaciones repetidas; después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode discovery requires source images inside the source tree. Select a source folder containing every source image, or copy linked images into that folder, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode discovery requires source images inside the source tree. Select a source folder containing every source image, or copy linked images into that folder, then preview again.
records.translation: La detección de códigos de barras requiere imágenes de origen dentro del árbol de origen. Seleccione una carpeta de origen que contenga todas las imágenes de origen, o copie las imágenes enlazadas en esa carpeta, y vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Barcode sidecar changed during conversion: {path}. Finish editing barcode.txt, preview the input again, and keep the file unchanged until conversion finishes.
records.source: Barcode sidecar changed during conversion: {path}. Finish editing barcode.txt, preview the input again, and keep the file unchanged until conversion finishes.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras cambió durante la conversión: {path}. Termine de editar barcode.txt, vuelva a previsualizar la entrada y no modifique el archivo hasta que termine la conversión.

records.key: Plate barcode input changed during conversion: {path}. Finish editing this input, preview again, and keep all barcode inputs unchanged until conversion finishes.
records.source: Plate barcode input changed during conversion: {path}. Finish editing this input, preview again, and keep all barcode inputs unchanged until conversion finishes.
records.translation: La entrada de códigos de barras de placa cambió durante la conversión: {path}. Termine de editar esta entrada, vuelva a previsualizar y no modifique ninguna entrada de códigos de barras hasta que termine la conversión.

records.key: custom_regex does not compile: {error}. Correct the reported syntax error in custom_regex, then preview the input again.
records.source: custom_regex does not compile: {error}. Correct the reported syntax error in custom_regex, then preview the input again.
records.translation: custom_regex no se puede compilar: {error}. Corrija el error de sintaxis indicado en custom_regex y, después, vuelva a previsualizar la entrada.

records.key: Barcode sidecar must be a stable regular file: {path}. Use a regular barcode.txt file at this path and keep it unchanged during preview and conversion.
records.source: Barcode sidecar must be a stable regular file: {path}. Use a regular barcode.txt file at this path and keep it unchanged during preview and conversion.
records.translation: El archivo auxiliar de códigos de barras debe ser un archivo normal estable: {path}. Use un archivo barcode.txt normal en esta ruta y no lo modifique durante la vista previa ni la conversión.

records.key: Barcode discovery cannot identify this source plate folder. For the plate/well layout, put each well folder inside a plate folder in the source folder, or select a layout matching the source folders, then preview again.
records.source: Barcode discovery cannot identify this source plate folder. For the plate/well layout, put each well folder inside a plate folder in the source folder, or select a layout matching the source folders, then preview again.
records.translation: La detección de códigos de barras no puede identificar esta carpeta de placa de origen. Para la disposición placa/pocillo, coloque cada carpeta de pocillo dentro de una carpeta de placa en la carpeta de origen o seleccione una disposición que coincida con las carpetas de origen y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: Conflicting barcode assignments for output plate {output}: {path}. Make the explicit output plate barcode and all barcode.txt assignments for this plate agree, then preview again.
records.source: Conflicting barcode assignments for output plate {output}: {path}. Make the explicit output plate barcode and all barcode.txt assignments for this plate agree, then preview again.
records.translation: Asignaciones de códigos de barras en conflicto para la placa de salida {output}: {path}. Haga que el código de barras explícito de la placa de salida y todas las asignaciones de barcode.txt para esta placa coincidan y, después, vuelva a previsualizar.

records.key: This installation cannot stage a verified update. Nothing was changed. Save your work, then update spaCR using the installer or package manager used for this installation.
records.source: This installation cannot stage a verified update. Nothing was changed. Save your work, then update spaCR using the installer or package manager used for this installation.
records.translation: Esta instalación no puede preparar una actualización verificada. No se modificó nada. Guarde su trabajo y, después, actualice spaCR con el instalador o el gestor de paquetes que usó para esta instalación.

records.key:
Update check unavailable: {error}

Restart spaCR and check for updates again. If this persists, report this error with the spaCR version and installation method.
records.source:
Update check unavailable: {error}

Restart spaCR and check for updates again. If this persists, report this error with the spaCR version and installation method.
records.translation:
La comprobación de actualizaciones no está disponible: {error}

Reinicie spaCR y vuelva a buscar actualizaciones. Si el problema persiste, informe de este error junto con la versión de spaCR y el método de instalación.

records.key: Could not apply settings. Previous settings restored. Check the log for the failed setting, correct it in Preferences, then apply again. If the log reports a write error, check write access to the configuration folder.
records.source: Could not apply settings. Previous settings restored. Check the log for the failed setting, correct it in Preferences, then apply again. If the log reports a write error, check write access to the configuration folder.
records.translation: No se pudieron aplicar los ajustes. Se han restaurado los ajustes anteriores. Consulte el registro para ver el ajuste que falló, corríjalo en Preferencias y vuelva a aplicar. Si el registro indica un error de escritura, compruebe el acceso de escritura a la carpeta de configuración.

records.key: A template needs a name. Enter a nonempty name in Rename template, then confirm again.
records.source: A template needs a name. Enter a nonempty name in Rename template, then confirm again.
records.translation: Una plantilla necesita un nombre. Escriba un nombre no vacío en Cambiar nombre de plantilla y vuelva a confirmar.

records.key: A template called {name} already exists. Enter a different name, or cancel and select the existing template.
records.source: A template called {name} already exists. Enter a different name, or cancel and select the existing template.
records.translation: Ya existe una plantilla llamada {name}. Escriba otro nombre, o cancele y seleccione la plantilla existente.

records.key: That file holds no settings. Export a settings CSV from the source module in spaCR, then import that file as a template.
records.source: That file holds no settings. Export a settings CSV from the source module in spaCR, then import that file as a template.
records.translation: Ese archivo no contiene ninguna configuración. Exporte un CSV de configuración desde el módulo de origen en spaCR y, después, importe ese archivo como plantilla.

records.key: This template is for the {source} module, not {target}. Open {source} to apply it, or choose a template saved for {target}.
records.source: This template is for the {source} module, not {target}. Open {source} to apply it, or choose a template saved for {target}.
records.translation: Esta plantilla es para el módulo {source}, no para {target}. Abra {source} para aplicarla o elija una plantilla guardada para {target}.

records.key: this screen cannot take settings. Open a module with a settings panel, then select a template for that module.
records.source: this screen cannot take settings. Open a module with a settings panel, then select a template for that module.
records.translation: esta pantalla no admite configuración. Abra un módulo con panel de configuración y, después, seleccione una plantilla para ese módulo.

records.key: this screen has no settings to capture. Open a module with a settings panel, set its values, then use Save template.
records.source: this screen has no settings to capture. Open a module with a settings panel, set its values, then use Save template.
records.translation: esta pantalla no tiene configuración que guardar. Abra un módulo con panel de configuración, establezca sus valores y, después, use Guardar plantilla.

records.key: not a spaCR settings template. Choose a JSON file created with Share template in spaCR.
records.source: not a spaCR settings template. Choose a JSON file created with Share template in spaCR.
records.translation: no es una plantilla de configuración de spaCR. Elija un archivo JSON creado con Compartir plantilla en spaCR.

records.key: Template format {version} is newer than this spaCR version reads (it reads formats up to {supported}). Choose a template created by this spaCR version, or open it with the spaCR version that saved it.
records.source: Template format {version} is newer than this spaCR version reads (it reads formats up to {supported}). Choose a template created by this spaCR version, or open it with the spaCR version that saved it.
records.translation: El formato de plantilla {version} es más reciente de lo que lee esta versión de spaCR (lee formatos hasta {supported}). Elija una plantilla creada con esta versión de spaCR o ábrala con la versión de spaCR que la guardó.

records.key: template has no settings. Save and share the template again from its original module, then import the new JSON file.
records.source: template has no settings. Save and share the template again from its original module, then import the new JSON file.
records.translation: la plantilla no contiene ajustes. Vuelva a guardar y compartir la plantilla desde su módulo original y, después, importe el nuevo archivo JSON.

records.key:
{name} is not valid JSON: {error}

Choose an intact JSON file created with Share template in spaCR, or export the template again from its original module.
records.source:
{name} is not valid JSON: {error}

Choose an intact JSON file created with Share template in spaCR, or export the template again from its original module.
records.translation:
{name} no es un JSON válido: {error}

Elija un archivo JSON intacto creado con Compartir plantilla en spaCR, o vuelva a exportar la plantilla desde su módulo original.

records.key: That template is for the {module} module. Open {module} to import it, or choose a template for the current module.
records.source: That template is for the {module} module. Open {module} to import it, or choose a template for the current module.
records.translation: Esa plantilla es para el módulo {module}. Abra {module} para importarla o elija una plantilla para el módulo actual.

records.key: {value!r} in rule {rule!r} is not a number. Replace the threshold with a number using a dot as the decimal separator, for example cell_area > 100.
records.source: {value!r} in rule {rule!r} is not a number. Replace the threshold with a number using a dot as the decimal separator, for example cell_area > 100.
records.translation: {value!r} en la regla {rule!r} no es un número. Sustituya el umbral por un número con punto como separador decimal, por ejemplo cell_area > 100.

records.key: No such file or folder: {path}. Check that the drive is connected, then choose an existing measurements.db file or its run folder.
records.source: No such file or folder: {path}. Check that the drive is connected, then choose an existing measurements.db file or its run folder.
records.translation: No existe el archivo o la carpeta: {path}. Compruebe que la unidad está conectada y, después, elija un archivo measurements.db existente o su carpeta de ejecución.

records.key: No {filename} under {folder}; expected {expected}. Choose a measurements.db file from a completed run, or select the run folder containing measurements/measurements.db.
records.source: No {filename} under {folder}; expected {expected}. Choose a measurements.db file from a completed run, or select the run folder containing measurements/measurements.db.
records.translation: No hay {filename} en {folder}; se esperaba {expected}. Elija un archivo measurements.db de una ejecución completada o seleccione la carpeta de ejecución que contiene measurements/measurements.db.

records.key: Unknown column {column!r} in this table. Reload the table and choose a column from the filter list.
records.source: Unknown column {column!r} in this table. Reload the table and choose a column from the filter list.
records.translation: Columna desconocida {column!r} en esta tabla. Vuelva a cargar la tabla y elija una columna de la lista de filtros.

records.key: Unknown operator {op!r}. Choose an operator from the filter list, such as = or contains.
records.source: Unknown operator {op!r}. Choose an operator from the filter list, such as = or contains.
records.translation: Operador desconocido {op!r}. Elija un operador de la lista de filtros, como = o contains.

records.key: ';' is not allowed in a filter. Remove the semicolon and enter one condition, such as cell_area > 100.
records.source: ';' is not allowed in a filter. Remove the semicolon and enter one condition, such as cell_area > 100.
records.translation: ';' no está permitido en un filtro. Elimine el punto y coma y escriba una sola condición, como cell_area > 100.

records.key: SQL comments are not allowed in the filter. Remove comment text and enter only the condition to apply.
records.source: SQL comments are not allowed in the filter. Remove comment text and enter only the condition to apply.
records.translation: Los comentarios SQL no están permitidos en el filtro. Elimine el texto del comentario y escriba solo la condición que quiere aplicar.

records.key: {keyword} is not allowed; filters only read. Enter a condition such as cell_area > 100, or turn off raw SQL and use the column/operator controls.
records.source: {keyword} is not allowed; filters only read. Enter a condition such as cell_area > 100, or turn off raw SQL and use the column/operator controls.
records.translation: {keyword} no está permitido; los filtros solo leen. Escriba una condición como cell_area > 100, o desactive SQL sin procesar y use los controles de columna y operador.

records.key: {column!r} is declared {label}; binary values cannot be edited as text. Leave this value unchanged, or use a database editor that supports binary fields.
records.source: {column!r} is declared {label}; binary values cannot be edited as text. Leave this value unchanged, or use a database editor that supports binary fields.
records.translation: {column!r} está declarada como {label}; los valores binarios no se pueden editar como texto. Deje este valor sin cambios o use un editor de bases de datos que admita campos binarios.

records.key: {value!r} is not a whole number, and {column!r} is declared {label}. Enter a whole number without a decimal point, such as 1.
records.source: {value!r} is not a whole number, and {column!r} is declared {label}. Enter a whole number without a decimal point, such as 1.
records.translation: {value!r} no es un número entero y {column!r} está declarada como {label}. Escriba un número entero sin punto decimal, como 1.

records.key: {value!r} is not a number, and {column!r} is declared {label}. Enter a number such as 1.5, using a dot as the decimal separator.
records.source: {value!r} is not a number, and {column!r} is declared {label}. Enter a number such as 1.5, using a dot as the decimal separator.
records.translation: {value!r} no es un número y {column!r} está declarada como {label}. Escriba un número como 1.5, con punto como separador decimal.

records.key: {table!r} has no rowid and no primary key, so spaCR cannot limit an edit to one row. Choose a table with a rowid or primary key; keep this table in read-only mode.
records.source: {table!r} has no rowid and no primary key, so spaCR cannot limit an edit to one row. Choose a table with a rowid or primary key; keep this table in read-only mode.
records.translation: {table!r} no tiene rowid ni clave primaria, por lo que spaCR no puede limitar una edición a una sola fila. Elija una tabla con rowid o clave primaria; mantenga esta tabla en modo de solo lectura.

records.key: No table named {table!r} in {database}. Reload the database and choose a table from its table list, or open the database that contains the required table.
records.source: No table named {table!r} in {database}. Reload the database and choose a table from its table list, or open the database that contains the required table.
records.translation: No hay ninguna tabla llamada {table!r} en {database}. Vuelva a cargar la base de datos y elija una tabla de su lista de tablas, o abra la base de datos que contiene la tabla necesaria.

records.key: Unknown column(s) for {table!r}: {columns}. Reload the table and select columns shown in its column list.
records.source: Unknown column(s) for {table!r}: {columns}. Reload the table and select columns shown in its column list.
records.translation: Columnas desconocidas para {table!r}: {columns}. Vuelva a cargar la tabla y seleccione columnas de su lista de columnas.

records.key: Row address is incomplete; the edit was refused. Reload the table, select the row again, and retry the edit.
records.source: Row address is incomplete; the edit was refused. Reload the table, select the row again, and retry the edit.
records.translation: La dirección de la fila está incompleta; se rechazó la edición. Vuelva a cargar la tabla, seleccione de nuevo la fila y vuelva a intentar la edición.

records.key: The UPDATE would have touched {rows} rows instead of one; it was rolled back. Reload the table and select the row again before retrying. If this repeats, stop editing and report the table name and this error.
records.source: The UPDATE would have touched {rows} rows instead of one; it was rolled back. Reload the table and select the row again before retrying. If this repeats, stop editing and report the table name and this error.
records.translation: La instrucción UPDATE habría modificado {rows} filas en lugar de una; se ha revertido. Vuelva a cargar la tabla y seleccione de nuevo la fila antes de reintentar. Si se repite, deje de editar e informe del nombre de la tabla y de este error.

records.key:
{error}

Review the selected gates and their measurement columns, correct the problem named above, then use Annotate from gates again.
records.source:
{error}

Review the selected gates and their measurement columns, correct the problem named above, then use Annotate from gates again.
records.translation:
{error}

Revise las regiones seleccionadas y sus columnas de medición, corrija el problema indicado arriba y, después, vuelva a usar Anotar desde regiones.

records.key: Each image must have exactly one matching mask. Select one mask per image with a matching field name, and remove duplicate or unmatched selections before copying.
records.source: Each image must have exactly one matching mask. Select one mask per image with a matching field name, and remove duplicate or unmatched selections before copying.
records.translation: Cada imagen debe tener exactamente una máscara coincidente. Seleccione una máscara por imagen con un nombre de campo coincidente y elimine las selecciones duplicadas o sin pareja antes de copiar.

records.key: Image and mask names are ambiguous or collide in the new folder. Give each image/mask pair a unique field name, then select the renamed files and copy again.
records.source: Image and mask names are ambiguous or collide in the new folder. Give each image/mask pair a unique field name, then select the renamed files and copy again.
records.translation: Los nombres de las imágenes y máscaras son ambiguos o entran en conflicto en la nueva carpeta. Asigne a cada par imagen/máscara un nombre de campo único y, después, seleccione los archivos renombrados y vuelva a copiar.

records.key: The destination already exists: {path}. Choose a new folder name that does not already exist, then copy again.
records.source: The destination already exists: {path}. Choose a new folder name that does not already exist, then copy again.
records.translation: El destino ya existe: {path}. Elija un nombre de carpeta nuevo que no exista y, después, vuelva a copiar.

records.key: Image or mask is missing or unsupported: {path}. Check that both files exist and can be opened as images, then select the pair again.
records.source: Image or mask is missing or unsupported: {path}. Check that both files exist and can be opened as images, then select the pair again.
records.translation: Falta una imagen o máscara, o su formato no es compatible: {path}. Compruebe que ambos archivos existen y se pueden abrir como imágenes y, después, vuelva a seleccionar el par.

records.key: Image and mask dimensions are incompatible: {image}. Choose a 2D image or an image with 1, 3, or 4 channels on the last axis, and a mask with matching height and width.
records.source: Image and mask dimensions are incompatible: {image}. Choose a 2D image or an image with 1, 3, or 4 channels on the last axis, and a mask with matching height and width.
records.translation: Las dimensiones de la imagen y la máscara son incompatibles: {image}. Elija una imagen 2D o una imagen con 1, 3 o 4 canales en el último eje, y una máscara con la misma altura y anchura.

records.key: The source changed while it was being copied: {path}. Wait for acquisition or any other process writing this image to finish, then copy again.
records.source: The source changed while it was being copied: {path}. Wait for acquisition or any other process writing this image to finish, then copy again.
records.translation: El origen cambió mientras se copiaba: {path}. Espere a que termine la adquisición o cualquier otro proceso que esté escribiendo esta imagen y, después, vuelva a copiar.

records.key:
The example pipeline could not be saved: {error}

Choose an existing folder you can write to and check free disk space, then export the pipeline again.
records.source:
The example pipeline could not be saved: {error}

Choose an existing folder you can write to and check free disk space, then export the pipeline again.
records.translation:
No se pudo guardar la canalización de ejemplo: {error}

Elija una carpeta existente en la que pueda escribir y compruebe el espacio libre en disco; después, vuelva a exportar la canalización.

records.key: {path} is not a spaCR graph style. Choose a JSON file created with Save graph style, then load it again.
records.source: {path} is not a spaCR graph style. Choose a JSON file created with Save graph style, then load it again.
records.translation: {path} no es un estilo de gráfico de spaCR. Elija un archivo JSON creado con Guardar estilo de gráfico y, después, vuelva a cargarlo.

records.key:
{error}

Review the selected measurement columns and clustering parameters named above, then run clustering again.
records.source:
{error}

Review the selected measurement columns and clustering parameters named above, then run clustering again.
records.translation:
{error}

Revise las columnas de medición seleccionadas y los parámetros de agrupamiento indicados arriba y, después, vuelva a ejecutar el agrupamiento.

records.key: {name} holds no image. Use Add image to choose a nonempty TIFF, PNG, JPEG, or BMP image that opens correctly in an image viewer.
records.source: {name} holds no image. Use Add image to choose a nonempty TIFF, PNG, JPEG, or BMP image that opens correctly in an image viewer.
records.translation: {name} no contiene ninguna imagen. Use Añadir imagen para elegir una imagen TIFF, PNG, JPEG o BMP no vacía que se abra correctamente en un visor de imágenes.

records.key: The image source is not loaded: {label}. Reload the source image in Overview and reopen custom export, or replace this box with an image file using Add image.
records.source: The image source is not loaded: {label}. Reload the source image in Overview and reopen custom export, or replace this box with an image file using Add image.
records.translation: El origen de imágenes no está cargado: {label}. Vuelva a cargar la imagen de origen en Vista general y vuelva a abrir la exportación personalizada, o sustituya este recuadro por un archivo de imagen con Añadir imagen.

records.key: This file is not a spaCR canvas layout. Choose a JSON file created with Save layout in the custom export window.
records.source: This file is not a spaCR canvas layout. Choose a JSON file created with Save layout in the custom export window.
records.translation: Este archivo no es una disposición de lienzo de spaCR. Elija un archivo JSON creado con Guardar disposición en la ventana de exportación personalizada.
